name: GALS! ~Namaiki Gyaru no Kateikyoushi Hajimemashita~
original_name: GALS!～生意気ギャルの家庭教師はじめました～
source:
Itsuki took on a part-time tutoring job through a friend’s recommendation. He agreed to it, lured by the promise of good pay—but his student turned out to be a *gyaru* who showed absolutely no interest in her studies.

"Hey, Itsuki—are you a virgin?"
"The way you’re acting all flustered... it’s just so obvious."

Instead of lessons, she hits him with questions that have nothing to do with academics.
Worse yet, the way she leaves her chest exposed so carelessly only serves to build up Itsuki’s building frustration...
translation:
经朋友介绍，树接下了一份家庭教师的兼职。冲着优厚时薪一口答应下来的他，到头来却发现自己的学生竟是个对学习毫无兴趣的辣妹。

“呐，树——你是处男吗？”
“看你慌成那样……简直一眼就能看穿嘛。”

她根本无心上课，反而接二连三地抛来与学业毫不相干的问题。
更糟糕的是，她那副毫不在意地敞露胸口的模样，只会让树心中积压的燥热愈演愈烈……
